paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Armenia, Belgium, Canada, China, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Pakistan, Poland, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor is linked to espionage campaigns, high-profile doxing efforts, and disruptive incidents that compromised targets believed to be of interest to the Russian government.

titolo: Targeting of financial institutions in Taiwan
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Antlion targeted financial institutions in Taiwan with a custom backdoor. The hackers stole data from the infected networks in what may have been a larger campaign to gain intelligence on the Taiwanese financial sector.

titolo: Targeting of the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior as part of espionage campaign
descrizione: Chinese threat actors targeted the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior as part of a wide-ranging cyberespionage campaign involving multiple threat actors. Belgian authorities condemned the activity.

titolo: Targeting of humanitarian, think tank, and governmental organizations
descrizione: Security researchers described a long-running domain-spoofing campaign run by a Chinese-sponsored threat actor aimed at various organizations, with a special interest in Taiwan.

titolo: Targeting of Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) email servers
descrizione: Chinese state-sponsored hackers breached the ASEAN email servers in February 2022, stealing over thirty gigabytes of data. That data is believed to contain information about the economic outlook and political conditions of member countries.

titolo: Targeting of a telecommunications firm in the Middle East and a government network in Asia
descrizione: Emissary Panda was spotted using a new variant of its SysUpdate backdoor to infiltrate the systems of a Middle Eastern telecommunications firm and a government network in Asia.

Previously known for targeting Southeast Asian governments, Sharp Panda (also known as Sharp Dragon) recently began leveraging compromised networks in Southeast Asia to breach governmental organizations in Africa and the Caribbean.

titolo: Targeting of a high-profile government organization in southeast Asia
descrizione: Sophos published a report detailing three clusters of activity targeting a high-profile government organization in Southeast Asia. Each cluster has some degree of known overlap with existing Chinese APTs and shares significant TTPs. All three targeted documents are suggested to be valuable to intelligence.
Velvet Ant is reported to have targeted an unnamed company in East Asia by infiltrating the company’s network through specific legacy appliances.

titolo: Targeting of an unnamed company in East Asia
descrizione: Velvet Ant is reported to have targeted an unnamed company in East Asia by infiltrating the company’s network through specific legacy appliances. Cybersecurity company Sygnia reported that Velvet Ant transferred its access to the network across devices in real time as it worked to remove access.

titolo: Targeting of governmental organizations in Africa and the Caribbean
descrizione: Sharp Panda (also known as Sharp Dragon) recently began leveraging previously compromised entities in Southeast Asia to send malicious emails to governmental organizations in Africa and the Caribbean.

titolo: Targeting of home internet routers to add to a botnet
descrizione: Volt Typhoon targeted unsupported or unpatched home and small office internet routers. Once the routers were compromised, they were used to obfuscate Volt Typhoon’s operations. The network also contained routers from a U.S. judicial organization and a satellite management firm, although it was unclear if these organizations were targeted beyond adding the routers to the […]

A Chinese threat actor, Chimera, gained access to the networks of Dutch chipmaker NXP and used that access to monitor employee communications and steal proprietary chip designs and other intellectual property. The breach lasted from late 2017 to early 2020.

Chimera is a Chinese threat actor with a focus accessing the networks of microchip manufacturers. The group was originally spotted targeting Taiwanese chipmakers but has expanded its targeting to other chipmaking firms across the world.

Chinese threat actors broke into the networks of at least twenty-four Cambodian government agencies over the past year. The affected agencies work on a variety of issues, including national defense, human rights, election oversight, trade and commerce, and telecommunications.

titolo: Targeting of semiconductor manufacturing firms in East Asia
descrizione: Emissary Panda launched phishing attacks against Chinese-speaking semiconductor firms in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Taiwan. The attack used malicious documents ostensibly from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, which, when downloaded, installed a malware dropper unique to Emissary Panda.

titolo: Targeting of government agency in Guyana
descrizione: An unknown Chinese-affiliated threat actor targeted a Guyanese government agency with spear-phishing emails. The actor used a series of previously unseen tools in the attack, including a remote access Trojan known as DinodasRAT.

titolo: Targeting of subsidiaries of global companies
descrizione: BlackTech, a Chinese threat actor, targeted public- and private-sector organizations, including industrial, technology, media, electronics, and telecommunications companies. It attacked the poorly secured systems of subsidiary companies and then escalated access to the parent companies’ network, sometimes by compromising the firmware of routers.

titolo: Targeting of a southeast Asian government
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted the systems of a southeast Asian government in a long-running campaign. The APT performed extensive reconnaissance on the network, identifying several usernames and machines that were likely of interest, and targeted those users with more extensive surveillance and tooling.

titolo: Targeting of a telecommunications provider in North Africa
descrizione: Mirage was detected targeting a telecommunications provider in North Africa. The attack appears to be an extension of an earlier Chinese campaign targeting telecommunications providers in the Middle East.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean academics, government agencies, and political groups
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Tick was found using spoofed domains to target South Korean political, government, and academic organizations. The attack appears aimed at gathering intelligence.

titolo: Targeting of the German Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy
descrizione: Mirage, a Chinese threat actor, broke into the networks of the German Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy in December of 2021. What information the attackers could have gained access to remains unclear.

titolo: Targeting of Uyghurs outside China with trojanized Signal and Telegram apps
descrizione: Mirage uploaded fake Signal and Telegram apps to the Google Play store. The apps were primarily marketed at Uyghurs living outside of China. Both were designed to steal users’ data, and the Telegram copy was downloaded by at least 13,953 different users.

titolo: Targeting of Japan’s National Center of Incident Readiness and Strategy for Cybersecurity
descrizione: Chinese hackers penetrated the email account of an employee of Japan’s National Center of Incident Readiness and Strategy for Cybersecurity. Japan officials feared that the attack could have indicated deeper penetration by Chinese hackers.

Flax Typhoon is a Chinese threat actor detected operating on the networks of Taiwanese organizations. Flax Typhoon is notable both for using living-off-the-land techniques to establish persistent access to various Taiwanese organizations’ networks and because it appears to only establish persistent access to a network, rather than inflicting damage or stealing information.

titolo: Targeting of government agencies across Eastern Europe
paesi_vittima: Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Ukraine, United Kingdom
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government agencies in Czechia, Hungary, Slovakia, Ukraine, and the United Kingdom with PlugX malware delivered through diplomatic-themed lure documents. There is also evidence that the hackers targeted agencies in France and Sweden as well, but whether they were successful in their attempts remains unclear.

titolo: Targeting of organizations using Barracuda email security gateway devices
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor compromised Barracuda brand email security gateway systems and used access to infiltrate networks attached to the Barracuda products. Once the campaign was detected, the attackers rapidly expanded their persistence on compromised systems, leading Barracuda to tell affected customers to destroy their devices due to the potential for continued compromise.

titolo: Targeting of government organizations in Eastern Europe and Western Asia
paesi_vittima: Estonia, Greece, Japan, Latvia, Taiwan, Turkey, United States
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government and civil-society networks in at least nine countries— including the United States, Greece, Japan, and the United Kingdom—with several new malware droppers.

titolo: Targeting of Taiwanese government and critical infrastructure operators
descrizione: Threat researchers discovered command-and-control infrastructure used by Emissary Panda to coordinate a campaign against Taiwanese government entities and critical infrastructure providers.

Chinese hackers targeted several ministries within Kenya’s government for several years. The hacks were primarily to gain information on Kenya’s ability to repay its debts associated with projects funded under China’s Belt and Road Initiative.

U.S. government agencies and Microsoft detected activity on critical infrastructure in the United States and Guam by a new Chinese threat actor dubbed Volt Typhoon. The attacks were primarily designed to gather information on U.S. critical infrastructure and military capabilities, but Microsoft and the agencies said the attacks could be preparation for a future attack […]

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications equipment in Guam
descrizione: Volt Typhoon is a threat actor that has been active since 2021 and targets various organizations, including educational institutions, information technology companies, military networks, and transportation groups for the purposes of espionage. The group primarily targets high-value victims and maintains persistent access through “living off the land” techniques and hands-on activity.

titolo: Targeting East Asian and Southeast Asian health-care, manufacturing, technology, and government organizations
descrizione: In its latest campaign, APT 41 targeted East Asian and Southeast Asian health-care, manufacturing, technology, and government organizations, attacking via installed Windows Defender in the target environment.

titolo: Targeting of military personnel and activists in Southeast Asia
descrizione: Patchwork, an Indian state-sponsored threat actor, used social engineering and spear-phishing lures to target military personnel and activists in Bangladesh, China, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Tibet.

titolo: Targeting Linux systems in Nepal and South Africa
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Gallium is using a new variant of the PingPull malware to target the Linux systems of finance, government, and telecommunications organizations across Africa, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

titolo: Targeting of a Taiwanese media organization
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor APT 41 targeted a Taiwanese media company with a phishing campaign that abused the Google command-and-control red teaming tool in order to steal data from victims.

titolo: Targeting of organizations of strategic interest to the Chinese government
descrizione: Winnti Umbrella, a Chinese state-sponsored threat actor, is continuing to target organizations of interest to the Chinese government (including government, media, and information technology organizations). The group was using Keyplug, a Linux version of the custom modular backdoor, to gain access to victims’ networks, exfiltrating information in line with espionage operations.

titolo: Targeting of Middle Eastern telecommunications providers
descrizione: The Chinese state actor Gallium targeted Middle Eastern telecommunications companies in a prolonged spear-phishing campaign dubbed Operation Soft Cell. After gaining access, attackers have been observed stealing credentials, performing general reconnaissance, and exfiltrating data.

titolo: Targeting of high-value customers of an East Asian data-loss prevention company
descrizione: Tick, a Chinese intelligence-aligned actor, compromised an internal update to the servers of a data-loss prevention company in order to deliver malware within the network. Tick packaged its malware as part of legitimate installers so that the malware was eventually executed on computers of the company’s customers.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. federal civilian agency
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Hafnium attacked an unnamed U.S. government civilian agency from August to January 2023. Hafnium exploited a known vulnerability in software in the agency’s Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

titolo: Targeting of infrastructure projects in Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor was detected targeting the strategic infrastructure projects of government organizations in Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Active since late 2022, the campaign uses spear-fishing emails for initial access and deploys the Soul malware framework once inside the network.

titolo: Targeting of Belgian member of Parliament
descrizione: Chinese actor Zirconium targeted a Belgian MP, Samuel Cogolati, with a spear-phishing attack. The attack came soon after Cogolati authored a resolution condemning the crimes against humanity committed against Uyghur Muslims in China’s Xinjiang region.

titolo: Targeting of Asian conglomerate in the materials sector
descrizione: Chinese APT Winnti Umbrella has been targeting multiple subsidiaries of an Asian conglomerate in the materials and composites sector using open-source malware. The group likely tried to steal intellectual property.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications and media firms in Vietnam
descrizione: China-backed threat actor Goblin Panda has been observed using lure documents with embedded malicious macros. The group deployed three major variants of ShellFang, a custom shellcode loader, against the telecommunications and media sectors in Vietnam throughout 2022.

Mirage, a Chinese threat actor, deployed a new backdoor, dubbed Turian, against the Iranian government in 2022. What agencies in the Iranian government were compromised, or what information Mirage found, is unclear.

titolo: Targeting of European government trade departments
descrizione: Chinese operators sent phishing emails disguised as memos on migration and trade policy to several different European governments. The campaign ran from September to November 2022 and utilized a new version of the modular PlugX malware.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. COVID relief funds
descrizione: APT 41 targeted the U.S. Small Business Administration and stole at least $20 million in U.S. COVID relief benefits allocated to businesses in several different U.S. states.

The U.S. National Security Agency issued a warning that two pieces of software from Citrix Systems, which are commonly used in corporate servers, had major vulnerabilities that were being actively exploited by APT 5.
Chinese threat actors compromised the networks of Amnesty International Canada to steal information on Amnesty’s investigations into Chinese human rights abuses.

titolo: Targeting of Chinese users with three zero days
descrizione: Ocean Lotus, a Vietnamese APT, was found deploying three zero days on Chinese networks. The attacks were primarily directed at gaining and expanding access to routers, networks, and cameras in China. Ocean Lotus could have also incorporated some of the compromised devices into its Torii botnet.

titolo: Targeting of Asian and Australian governments and government partners
paesi_vittima: Australia, Japan, Myanmar, Taiwan, The Philippines
descrizione: China-affiliated APT Mustang Panda conducted a spear-fishing campaign against several Asian governments starting in March 2022. Mustang Panda used two new malware families, Toneins and Toneshell, in the campaign.

titolo: Targeting of Asian government agencies and certificate authorities
descrizione: Chinese-affiliated APT Thrip compromised a digital certificate authority in an Asian country. Thrip likely used the certificates to sign malware used to target government agencies for the last six months.
Chinese-affiliated threat actor APT 15 led a mobile surveillance campaign against Uyghurs in China and abroad using BadBazaar malware masquerading as Android apps.

Chinese-affiliated group Poison Carp conducted a mobile surveillance campaign against Uyghurs in China and abroad using Android exploit and malware kit Moonshine. This is the second time Moonshine has reportedly been used; the first was in 2019 to surveil Tibetan activists.

titolo: Targeting of companies in Hong Kong
descrizione: Winnti Umbrella targeted government organizations in Hong Kong with malware to steal sensitive data from victims. The attacks are likely an expansion of Operation CuckooBees, previously documented in May 2022, which targeted businesses’ networks in the United States and Europe to steal intellectual property.
Researchers found that Chinese-sponsored hacking group Winnti stole documents from the Sri Lankan government and remotely accessed software from August to October 2022.
Mustang Panda launched a watering-hole attack by impersonating Burmese news outlets to gain access to Myanmar’s government networks.

titolo: Targeting of governments in the Middle East and Africa
descrizione: APT 10 installed web shells on public-facing servers and extracted information from Middle Eastern governments and an African stock exchange.

titolo: Targeting of an Asian IT provider
descrizione: Cybersecurity researchers identified a new campaign run by a Webworm, a Chinese cyber-espionage group. The campaign is in its early stages and appears to use publicly available malware to breach systems and steal information.

Researchers identified a Chinese cyber-espionage group that has exchanged tools with Winnti Umbrella, APT 27, and Mustang Panda. The group has been observed using repurposed, publicly available malware in espionage campaigns throughout Asia since at least early 2022. The group could also be moonlighting as criminal hackers, as they have been observed attacking Chinese companies […]

titolo: Targeting of government officials in Europe, the Middle East, and South America
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government organizations in a phishing campaign. The campaign used PlugX, a frequently implemented Chinese modular malware tool.

China accused the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) of hacking into the networks of Northwestern Polytechnical University, a prominent defense research university in Xi’an, in June 2022. Some researchers expressed doubt at the claims, as the report accused the NSA of using a tool more than ten years old that was leaked more than five […]

titolo: Targeting of Australian, Malaysian, and European organizations and organizations operating in and around the South China Sea.
descrizione: APT 40 launched an espionage campaign targeting Australian, European, and Asian organizations involved in maintaining and producing wind turbines in the South China Sea, as well as Malaysian organizations working in the Kasawari gas field.

titolo: Targeting of industrial enterprises and public institutions in Central Asia and Eastern Europe
descrizione: Chinese hackers used phishing emails to plant PortDoor malware on the systems of industrial organizations in Afghanistan, Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine. Security researchers detected the hackers exfiltrating data to a server with a Chinese IP address.

titolo: Targeting of military and public institutions in Afghanistan and several east European countries
descrizione: The attackers sent phishing emails containing a malicious Microsoft Word document, which installed multiple Backdoors on targeted systems. The group likely used that access to conduct espionage.

titolo: Targeting of the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior by Chinese threat actors
descrizione: Chinese threat actors targeted the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior as part of a wide-ranging cyber espionage campaign involving multiple threat actors. Belgian authorities condemned the activity.

titolo: Targeting of the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior in Chinese espionage campaign
descrizione: Chinese threat actors targeted the Belgian Federal Public Service Interior as part of a wide-ranging cyberespionage campaign involving multiple threat actors. Belgian authorities condemned the activity.

Chinese threat actors targeted the Belgian Defense Ministry as part of a wide-ranging cyberespionage campaign involving multiple threat actors, which also targeted the Interior Service. Belgian authorities condemned the activity.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. political reporters and White House correspondents
descrizione: Since 2021, Zirconium, a Chinese threat actor, has carried out phishing attacks against U.S.-based journalists to uncover sensitive information about U.S. politics.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications companies operating in Africa, Europe, and Southeast Asia
descrizione: Gallium, a Chinese APT, is thought to have operated since 2012 and primarily targets telecommunications companies, financial institutions, and governments. The group has previously used advanced, difficult-to-detect malware in its campaigns.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Myanmar, Vietnam
descrizione: This Chinese threat actor has operated since 2013 and targets government, education, and telecommunication organizations in Australia and Southeast Asia. Aoqin Dragon seeks initial access primarily through document exploits and fake removable devices such as USB drives.

titolo: Targeting of major telecommunications and network service providers
descrizione: Chinese-backed threat actors identified vulnerabilities to gain access to major telecommunication companies and network service providers to access and exfiltrate victim data.

titolo: Targeting of Palauans via an Australian telecommunications company
descrizione: Chinese threat actor APT 40 was found using a zero-day in Microsoft Office products, dubbed Follina, as part of a spear-phishing campaign against targets in Palau.

A Chinese threat actor was found using a zero-day vulnerability, dubbed Follina, in Microsoft Office products to distribute zero-click malware. The attackers used Follina to target Tibetan organizations and Tibetans living abroad with malware.

A Chinese threat actor targeted two research institutes run by Rostec, a major Russian state-owned defense conglomerate. The attackers used spear-phishing lures to plant malware and steal data on Russian radar and electronic warfare capabilities.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Korea (Republic of), Myanmar, Turkey, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor believed to have used a custom backdoor to target telecommunications providers and entities in the government, education, and logistics sectors in the United States, Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, South Korea, Turkey, and Vietnam.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications providers across the United States, Asia, and the Middle East
paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Korea (Republic of), Myanmar, Turkey, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Red Menshen used a custom backdoor dubbed BPFDoor to target telecommunications providers, government systems, postal and logistic systems, and others in the United States, Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, South Korea, Turkey, and Vietnam. Red Menshen moved laterally across Windows systems, sending commands via a virtual private server that were administered by compromised […]

titolo: Targeting of technology and manufacturing companies in Asia, Europe, and North America
paesi_vittima: Germany, Japan, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Chinese APT Winnti Umbrella targeted technology and manufacturing companies across Asia, Europe, and North America in a sophisticated cyber espionage campaign that began in 2019. Winnti used a novel strain of malware to exfiltrate the victims’ intellectual property, including documents, blueprints, diagrams, formulas, and manufacturing-related proprietary data.

Chinese threat actor Mustang Panda targeted Russian government computer systems with PlugX malware. The malware was disguised in a malicious file masquerading as a PDF, which was named after a Russian border guard unit.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunication companies, internet service providers, and the data services sector
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Hafnium targeted an un-patched zero-day vulnerability in Zoho products to implant a web shell. Hafnium exploited the Windows Task Scheduler to execute hidden scheduled tasks, allowing the malware to avoid detection.

titolo: Targeting of organizations in Asia, Europe, and North America
paesi_vittima: Australia, Japan, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Chinese threat actor APT 10 used a vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange to gain access to victims’ networks, where the attackers deployed a custom loader and the Sodamaster backdoor. APT 10 also used a custom loader to obtain credentials. The attackers spent up to nine months in victims’ networks.

The Chinese threat actor Scarab targeted Ukrainian government officials with lure documents used to load HeaderTip malware onto target systems. The lure documents mimic releases from the National Police of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of American state governments’ networks
descrizione: The Chinese cyber threat group APT41 conducted an extended campaign targeting the networks of at least six U.S. state governments. For over a year, APT41 exploited internet-facing web applications and leveraged a zero-day vulnerability in the USAHerds application used by many state governments, gaining access to the broader networks of state governments.

titolo: Targeting of European diplomatic entities, research entities, and internet service providers
descrizione: The Chinese-linked threat actor Mustang Panda targeted European diplomatic entities with malicious files containing geopolitical themes, including a file titled “Situation at the EU borders with Ukraine.zip.” The hackers used a European diplomat’s compromised email address to send the malware-laced emails to other countries’ diplomatic offices.

The Chinese threat actor APT10 used a vulnerability in a web interface to install a version of the Quasar remote access Trojan. The attack was initially overlooked because of the focus on a credential stuffing attack, where hackers use mass amounts of previously stolen information to try to break into a system, seemingly conducted by APT10 to […]
Chinese hackers exploited the Log4Shell vulnerability in order to enter the systems of an Australian media outlet and access passwords and data.

titolo: Targeting of journalists at News Corp
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor hacked the email accounts of journalists employed at American media company News Corp. The attackers aimed to uncover journalists’ sources, as well as drafts of upcoming articles. No consumer or financial data was compromised.

titolo: Targeting of German pharmaceutical and technology firms
descrizione: The Chinese group APT27 was detected launching attacks starting in 2021 against German companies. The attacks were primarily directed at technology and pharmaceutical firms. The group stole trade secrets and intellectual property and also aimed to use its access in certain companies to launch spear-phishing attacks against other targets.

The Chinese group Emissary Panda installed malware inside the corporate networks of German companies. The actor may have attempted to steal business secrets and intellectual property, target customers, and use its access to the companies’ networks to conduct a supply chain attack.

titolo: Targeting of transportation companies via UEFI firmware implant
descrizione: The Winnti group is suspected of deploying an advanced Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) implant, dubbed Moonbounce, to the systems of a transportation company. Moonbounce is highly targeted and was likely created to access the networks of a small number of institutions and companies.

Earth Lusca is a threat actor that targets organizations of interest to the Chinese government, including academic institutions, telecommunication companies, religious organizations, and other civil society groups. Earth Lusca’s tools closely resemble those used by Winnti Umbrella, but the group appears to operate separately from Winnti. Earth Lusca has also been observed targeting cryptocurrency payment […]

The North Korean cyber gang Lazarus Group was accused of attempting to breach Chinese cyber espionage groups’ systems in 2020 in an effort to exploit zero-days and other vulnerabilities. The effort is likely related to an earlier North Korean attempt to attack cybersecurity researchers in the United States and Eastern Europe.
IronHusky was detected using a Windows zero-day to launch a remote access Trojan dubbed MysterySnail.  Command and control infrastructure IronHusky use has been active since at least 2012.

paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Brazil, Indonesia, Russian Federation, Thailand, Turkey
descrizione: Calypso has been observed targeting government agencies worldwide since 2016, including institutions in Brazil, Indonesia, Russia, Thailand, and Turkey. The group was also implicated in a breach of Afghan telecommunication company Roshan.

titolo: Targeting of Afghan telecommunication firm Roshan
descrizione: An email server controlled by the Afghan telecommunication company Roshan was targeted by a Chinese threat actor since at least early 2021. Calypso’s data exfiltration activity spiked in August and September 2021, coinciding with the United States military’s withdrawal from Afghanistan.
A Chinese threat actor was found using phishing attacks to gain access to the systems of several Indian media groups.
A Chinese threat actor had access to servers used to store Indonesian intelligence records for at least five months in the spring and summer of 2021.

titolo: Targeting of Microsoft Exchange and MySQL servers
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor that had been launching attacks using the novel backdoor technique SideWalk for several months is associated with the Chinese threat actor Winnti Umbrella. The attacks targeted businesses and academic institutions in the United States.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. computer retail business
descrizione: Winnti Umbrella was found to have repurposed a backdoor, known as Crosswalk, to infiltrate the systems of a computer retailer in the United States.
While investigating a breach of Air India’s data systems, cybersecurity researchers stumbled on a previously undetected intrusion into Air India’s systems likely carried out by Chinese threat actors.
As part of a broader espionage campaign spanning multiple countries, Chinese-linked APT UNC215 inserted malware into Israeli government computers to extract data

titolo: Targeting of Southeast Asian telecommunication companies
descrizione: In a series of attacks starting in 2017, Chinese threat actors are believed to have compromised telecommunication firms across Southeast Asia. The breaches were designed to extract data from the companies’ servers and were likely used to launch more targeted spear-phishing attacks.

titolo: Targeting of the United States, Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, and Russia in an espionage operation
paesi_vittima: Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, Russian Federation, United States
descrizione: APT 31 was detected using a new remote access Trojan horse in more than ten attacks throughout the first half of 2021 to target governmental groups in Russia and several other countries.

titolo: Targeting of French corporations using compromised Wi-Fi routers
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor operated a long-term campaign to break into home Wi-Fi routers and launch reconnaissance attacks against French companies and organizations.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. oil and gas companies
descrizione: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency released the indicators of compromise for a series of attacks on U.S. oil and gas companies, which lasted from 2011 to 2013. The agency confirmed that at least twenty companies had been compromised and that the depth of the intrusions was not entirely clear.

titolo: Targeting of Philippine and Nepalese governments
descrizione: Kaspersky Labs detected a high-volume campaign in Southeast Asia primarily aimed at government agencies in Myanmar, Nepal, and the Philippines. The attackers used a compromised version of the popular video conference application Zoom to break into computers.

titolo: Targeting of civil society groups in Nepal, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Hong Kong
paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, Nepal, Taiwan, The Philippines
descrizione: Chinese state-sponsored hackers were detected infiltrating networks in Nepal, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, with a focus on academic and governmental networks.

titolo: Targeting of the Afghan National Security Council
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor targeted the Afghan National Security Council with spear-phishing attacks. The attackers pretended to be from the Administrative Office of the President of Afghanistan to get victims to download a dropper.
IndigoZebra has been observed targeting Afghanistan and former Soviet republics, including Krygzstan and Uzbekistan.

titolo: Targeting of Norwegian government’s IT network
descrizione: An investigation by the Norwegian Police Security Service (PST) found that a 2018 breach of the government’s IT systems was carried out by a Chinese threat actor. The hackers removed large amounts of data in the breach, although the PST is still unsure of exactly how much data or what files were taken

titolo: Targeting of major companies and government organizations in seven countries
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor was detected running a cyber espionage campaign since at least 2014 in Afghanistan, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan. Attackers compromised numerous companies in a variety of industries, along with government and military systems.

paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan
descrizione: RedFoxTrot, a group associated with PLA Unit 69010, ran a long-term cyber espionage campaign since at least 2014 directed primarily toward countries in Central Asia, as well as Afghanistan, India, and Pakistan. The group is believed to operate out of Xinjiang.

Chinese-linked hacking group TA428 is believed to be responsible for a series of attacks on the Russian government in late 2020. The goal of the attackers was to penetrate officials’ emails and classified networks and steal information.

titolo: Targeting of Southeast Asian ministry of foreign affairs
descrizione: A South Asian government was targeted as part of a long-running cyber espionage campaign carried out by a Chinese threat actor. The campaign used spear phishing to drop malware onto the government’s systems.

The Chinese hacking group Red Echo inserted malicious code into a download link on the webpage for Myanmar’s president. This marks the second time Myanmar’s presidential website has been used in watering-hole attacks by Chinese hackers.

titolo: Targeting of Uyghurs in China and Pakistan
descrizione: Chinese hackers distributed malware pretending to be a UN document on funding for displaced Uyghurs. The hackers impersonated several UN websites for most of 2020 to spread the malware and communicate with infected systems.
Chinese-linked hackers targeted the general director of a Russian nuclear submarine design company with a spear-phishing email designed to share a malicious link.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. federal agencies via PulseSecure VPN
descrizione: Five U.S. federal agencies were targeted in a Chinese espionage operation, along with several defense contractors and financial institutions in the country. The hackers made use of zero-day vulnerabilities in the PulseSecure VPN system to gain access to the different organizations’ systems.

titolo: Targeting of Japanese businesses and research groups
descrizione: A Chinese-sponsored threat actor known as Tick is believed to have breached hundreds of businesses and research institutes in Japan, including the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency. The threat actor is believed to have gained access to the businesses through a compromised rental server.

titolo: Targeting of the Vietnamese and Thai governments and military
descrizione: APT 27 conducted a wide-ranging espionage campaign to gather data from a variety of institutions throughout Southeast Asia, primarily concentrated in Vietnam.

titolo: Targeting of Uyghur activists, journalists, and dissidents
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Kazakhstan, Syrian Arab Republic, Turkey, United States
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Evil Eye used fake Facebook profiles and websites that masqueraded as legitimate Turkish and Uyghur news sites to disseminate malicious links to Uyghur activists around the world.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, United States
descrizione: The Chinese APT Mustang Panda phished telecommunications companies’ employees by sending them malicious domains masquerading as Huawei’s career site.

titolo: Targeting of Linux endpoints and servers
descrizione: Chinese threat actors used a new sophisticated backdoor called RedXOR to target Linux endpoints and servers.

titolo: Targeting of the Parliament of Western Australia
descrizione: Chinese hackers exploited a Microsoft vulnerability to target the Parliament of Western Australia’s email server.

titolo: Targeting of organizations via Microsoft Exchange Server vulnerability
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Hafnium exploited vulnerabilities in the Microsoft Exchange Server to access the emails of hundreds of thousands of entities across the globe.

The Chinese APT believed to be behind the exploitation of vulnerabilities in the Microsoft Exchange email server to access user emails. Historically, Hafnium has primarily targeted entities in the United States.
APT 10 targeted Indian vaccine makers Bharat Biotech and the Serum Institute of India for espionage purposes.
Amid mounting border tensions between China and India in 2020, Chinese threat actors allegedly infected India’s power grid’s control systems with malware.

Chinese APT Lucky Cat has been using a malicious Mozilla Firefox browser extension dubbed FriarFox to infiltrate and control targets’ Gmail accounts. Primary objectives of the actor appear to be espionage and surveillance of dissidents, including the Tibetan diaspora.

Suspected Chinese hackers breached SolarWinds software, potentially accessing payroll information for hundreds of thousands of federal employees. Details about specific actors and the scale of the breach remain unknown.

Chinese threat actor Emissary Panda locked the servers of five gambling firms marketing to Chinese nationals, requesting $100 million in ransom payment. The victim companies reported that no payment was made.
The China-affiliated threat actor Mustang Panda stole security footage from the African Union headquarters. Hackers had access to meeting rooms, hallways, and parking lots.

The Chinese threat actor Emissary Panda compromised Able Desktop chat software used by over 430 Mongolian government agencies and a national data center. The ShadowPad backdoor, previously attributed to a suspected subset of the Winnti Umbrella, was also used.

titolo: Targeting of Japanese companies and global subsidiaries
descrizione: APT 10 used a wide range of tools, many publicly available, to infect Japanese companies and their global subsidiaries with malware for reconnaissance purposes.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government agency networks
descrizione: Chinese hackers scanned networks in search of virtual private network (VPN) and email server vulnerabilities with the aim of exfiltrating data.
A Chinese actor that uses DLL side-loading to install malware on targeted systems.

titolo: Targeting of nongovernmental organizations in Myanmar
descrizione: Chinese hackers used DLL side-loading to install malware on nongovernmental organizations’ systems in Myanmar.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. military and defense computer networks
descrizione: Chinese hackers used publicly known vulnerabilities to infiltrate military and defense networks containing sensitive intellectual property, state secrets, and other information.

titolo: Targeting of Japanese companies involved in COVID-19 vaccine development
descrizione: Chinese hackers used phishing emails to deliver malware disguised as new coronavirus information. No data appears to have been successfully exfiltrated.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. individuals with fake McAfee software installations
descrizione: Hackers impersonating McAfee antivirus software emailed links that would download malware from GitHub onto victims’ computers.

titolo: Targeting of entities in India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Malaysia, Russia, and Ukraine
paesi_vittima: India, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Russian Federation, Ukraine
descrizione: Chinese hackers distributed SlothfulMedia malware, which modifies files and logs keystrokes. Specific targets have yet to be disclosed.

Responsible for targeting email accounts belonging to former Vice President Joe Biden’s campaign staff and for attempting to discern whether accounts belonging to members of the international affairs community are active.

titolo: Targeting of former Vice President Joe Biden’s campaign staff and U.S. international affairs community
descrizione: Responsible for targeting non-campaign email accounts belonging to former Vice President Biden’s election campaign staff. Also responsible for using web bugs to determine whether accounts belonging to academics and important figures in the international affairs community are active.

Responsible for targeting governments in Asia, particularly in Taiwan but also in Hong Kong and Japan. They used Taidoor malware to steal information from Taiwanese government agencies and official email accounts.

titolo: Targeting of Taiwanese government agencies and officials’ email accounts
descrizione: Hackers exploited vulnerabilities in at least four Taiwanese tech companies that provided information technology services to the government using the Taidoor malware, allowing them far-reaching access to official systems and accounts since at least 2018.

titolo: Targeting of entities focusing on Taiwan
descrizione: Hackers targeted various entities involved in Taiwan-related issues with spear-phishing emails containing Taidoor, a remote-access trojan (RAT) designed to maintain a presence on victim networks for use in later network exploitation.

titolo: Targeting of Vatican City computer networks
descrizione: Hackers conducted an espionage campaign against Vatican City beginning in May 2020. In one instance, embedded malware was sent using the email of the Vatican Secretary of State. Hackers were likely trying to gain information on the Vatican’s negotiating position prior to high-level talks between the Catholic Church and Beijing in September 2020 regarding a […]

titolo: Targeting of Western entities involved in COVID-19 vaccine development
descrizione: Hackers conducted a combination of financially motivated and espionage-driven hacking operations against hundreds of companies, organizations, and research firms based in the United States and other countries, stealing terabytes of information.

titolo: Targeting of Australian government agencies and private companies
descrizione: Hackers believed by Australian officials to be operating on behalf of China targeted Australian government agencies and companies through a known exploit in Microsoft Sharepoint.
Hackers leveraged a backdoor to compromise Taiwanese and South Korean video game companies’ systems.

titolo: Targeting of companies in Central Asia
descrizione: A group using tools similar to Chinese government–affiliated group Vicious Panda targeted high-profile companies in Central Asia and planting backdoors to gain access to corporate networks. The group is also believed to be behind cyberattacks in Belarus, Mongolia, and Russia.

Cyber actors affiliated with the Chinese government attempted to identify and illicitly obtain intellectual property and public health data related to vaccines, treatments, and testing from networks and personnel associated with COVID-19–related research.

titolo: Targeting of government bodies in Australia and Southeast Asia
paesi_vittima: Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Indonesia, Myanmar, Thailand, The Philippines, Vietnam
descrizione: Using a new exploit named Aria-body, APT 30 attempted to compromise networks belonging to governments and state-owned companies in Australia and Southeast Asia.
China-linked Winnti Umbrella launched a ransomware attack against Taiwan’s state oil company, CPC Corporation, causing its website to go offline for one day.
Pirate Panda is believed to be responsible for phishing attacks targeting Vietnamese government officials located near the disputed Paracel Islands in the South China Sea.
The Chinese-linked threat actor Pirate Panda sent phishing emails to Vietnamese government officials located in Da Nang, Vietnam.

titolo: Targeting of Wuhan government and China’s Ministry of Emergency Management
descrizione: Vietnamese hackers sent spear-phishing messages to the Wuhan government and China’s Ministry of Emergency Management.
Performed highly targeted watering-hole attacks on visitors to Tibetan websites.

titolo: Targeting of Tibetans via watering-hole attacks
descrizione: The Chinese hackers Storm Cloud performed highly targeted watering-hole attacks on visitors to a few Tibetan websites and tried to make them install fake versions of Adobe Flash.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, India, Italy, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, The Philippines, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor APT 41 attempted to exploit three vulnerabilities at over seventy-five organizations across sectors and countries. This was one of the most widespread attacks by a Chinese threat actor in years.

titolo: Targeting of Hong Kong citizens with mobile malware
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Lotus Blossom used watering holes on fake news sites to deploy iOS exploits against Hong Kong citizens.
Conducted coronavirus-related phishing campaign against targets in the Mongolian government.

titolo: Targeting of the Mongolian government using coronavirus-related lures
descrizione: The suspected Chinese threat actor Vicious Panda conducted a coronavirus-related phishing campaign against targets in the Mongolian government.

titolo: Targeting of Japan, Russia, and South Korean entities
descrizione: The Chinese government–aligned APT Tonto Team used Bisonal malware for over ten years in various campaigns against entities in Japan, Russia, and South Korea.
Chinese government-aligned APT that used Bisonal malware for over ten years in various campaigns against entities in Japan, Russia, and South Korea.

APT 40, a threat actor believed to be associated with the Chinese government, allegedly targeted Malaysian government officials with highly targeted spear-phishing attacks in order to install malware and steal confidential documents from government networks.

titolo: Infection of computer systems belonging to universities in Hong Kong
descrizione: The Winnti Umbrella, a Chinese government-backed threat actor, installed malware on computer systems at two universities in Hong Kong during protests. Three other universities in Hong Kong could have been simultaneously targeted.

titolo: Stolen data on nearly two thousand Mitsubishi employees
descrizione: The China-linked Bronze Butler threat actor is suspected to have used a zero-day in Trend Micro antivirus to attack Mitsubishi Electric and steal data on thousands of employees. In May 2020, it was disclosed that the breach resulted in the theft of specifications for a hypersonic missile that Japan had been developing to protect disputed territory […]

titolo: Targeting of nongovernmental organizations and political and law enforcement agencies in East and South Asia
descrizione: The China-affiliated threat actor Bronze President attacked nongovernmental organizations, political agencies, and law enforcement in Mongolia and India, among other countries.
A China-aligned attacker bypassed virtual private network (VPN) accounts protected by two-factor authentication to attack governments and managed service providers in a multitude of industries.

titolo: Targeting of telecom companies across Africa, Europe, and Southeast Asia
descrizione: Gallium, an allegedly China-aligned threat actor, attacked telecom companies across the globe for several months.
Gallium is a possibly China-linked threat actor that has carried out attacks against telecom companies across the globe.
The China-linked threat actor group Rancor targeted unnamed Cambodian government entities.

titolo: Attack on forum of Hong Kong protesters
descrizione: China’s government used its “Great Cannon” distributed denial of service (DDOS) system for the first time in two years to attack a forum where Hong Kong residents organized protests.

titolo: Attack of  Japanese companies with links to China
descrizione: China-linked espionage group Bronze Butler targeted companies with head offices in Japan and subsidiaries in China to try to steal highly classified information.
Chinese government hackers attacked the National Association of Manufacturers to steal information that might be useful in U.S.-China trade negotiations.
China-aligned hackers breached Czech-based Avast’s network, aiming to compromise the CCleaner tool, which had previously been compromised in 2017.

titolo: Targeting of European and North American aerospace companies
descrizione: A threat actor conducted a multiyear espionage effort aimed at the theft of intellectual property from European and North American aerospace companies to further the development of China’s C919 aircraft.
A Chinese-linked threat actor group active in Southeast Asia

titolo: Attacks in East and Southeast Asia
descrizione: Chinese government threat actor PKplug targeted organizations in East and Southeast Asia.
Two Chinese government threat actors used a number of zero-day vulnerabilities in common Japanese software to target Japanese organizations over the course of several years.

A threat actor targeted virtual private networks (VPNs) used by suppliers of European aerospace company Airbus with a series of attacks. The attacks resulted in unauthorized access to data, including the theft of documents related to Airbus’s military transport plane A400M, designed with one of the most powerful propeller engines in the world.

titolo: Targeting of senior members of Tibetan groups
descrizione: A threat actor aimed to infect mobile phones belonging to senior members of Tibetan groups, including people who worked directly for the Dalai Lama and lawmakers in Tibet’s parliament. The threat actor posed as a human rights worker or journalist and contacted victims through WhatsApp. The campaign involved Android browser vulnerabilities and Android and iOS […]

This threat actor has targeted senior members of Tibetan groups by sending malicious links in WhatsApp messages, while posing as nongovernmental organization workers, journalists, or other fake personas.

titolo: Targeting of enterprise VPN servers from Fortinet and Pulse Secure
descrizione: Multiple threat actors targeted secure sockets layer (SSL) virtual private network (VPN) servers provided by cybersecurity companies Fortinet and Pulse Secure. It is uncertain whether the attacks were successful.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications operators in countries through which Uighurs are known to travel
descrizione: Multiple threat actors compromised telecoms networks across Central and Southeast Asia. The attacks were part of a wider cyber-espionage campaign targeting diplomats and state officials, and they signal China’s ability and intent to track the movements of Uighurs along a number of transit routes that they use to escape state persecution.

titolo: Compromise of websites related to Uighur communities
descrizione: Multiple threat actors compromised and exploited eleven websites that published news and cultural information related to the Uighur populations in China, particularly the East Turkestan region. The threat actors imitated the domains of Google, the Turkistan Times, and the Uyghur Academy, and used Google applications to gain access to Gmail accounts. Among other sensitive details […]

titolo: Autumn Aperture—use of malicious websites to target foreign ministries and other entities
paesi_vittima: China, France, Slovakia, South Africa, United States
descrizione: A threat actor targeted a number of foreign ministries, a Chinese technology company, Stanford University, think tanks in the United States and the United Kingdom, and other entities that have focused on North Korea’s nuclear efforts or the related international sanctions. The threat actor created a network of malicious websites imitating the login portals of […]

titolo: Targeting of the Australian Parliament, including the Liberal, National, and Labor Parties
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the computer network of the Parliament of Australia. The hackers breached the Parliament’s network and the networks of the three largest political parties.

paesi_vittima: France, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor has, since 2014, conducted operations backed by the Chinese government, including targeting the health-care and high-tech sectors and conducting espionage against political dissidents. It has simultaneously conducted its own for-profit illicit activity in the video games industry, amassing millions of dollars in digital currency to be sold to gamers on the black […]

titolo: Targeting of German energy technology, chemicals, and consumer goods companies, among others
descrizione: A threat actor used a Trojan horse to gain remote backdoor access to German energy technology company Siemens, chemical firm BASF, and consumer goods company Henkel. Non-German companies Roche, Lion Air, and Marriott were also targeted.
This threat actor hacked global telecommunications companies for personal data of government officials, activists, and dissidents of interest to Beijing.

titolo: Chinese intelligence repurposed NSA tools to attack private companies
descrizione: The threat actor repurposed hacking tools used against them by the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) to attack private companies in Asia and Europe. These attacks went undetected for two years.

titolo: Compromise of Amnesty International Hong Kong
descrizione: This threat actor compromised Amnesty International Hong Kong’s system to steal the personal information of supporters.
A threat actor put malicious software on Bayer’s computer system but did not steal any information, as reported by the company.
Senior Indonesian election officials accused Chinese and Russian hackers of manipulating and modifying Indonesia’s voter data base to disrupt the presidential elections.

titolo: Targeting of universities’ maritime military secrets
descrizione: Chinese hackers targeted twenty-seven universities in the United States, Canada, and Southeast Asia as part of a scheme to steal research about maritime technology under development for military use.
Hackers used malware from the dark web to target a Norwegian internet service provider. The goal of the attack was to gain access to customers’ intellectual property, strategic plans, and emails.

titolo: Compromise of Managed Service Providers and technology companies
paesi_vittima: India, Japan, South Africa, Sweden, United States
descrizione: The threat actor compromised eight technology service providers, including Hewlett Packard Enterprise and IBM (their cloud services in particular were targeted), to steal commercial secrets from over forty-five client technology companies. The victims include Swedish telecom giant Ericsson, U.S. Navy shipbuilder Huntington Ingalls Industries, and travel reservation system Sabre.

titolo: Compromise of the EU’s diplomatic communication network
descrizione: Hackers have infiltrated the EU’s diplomatic communication network for years, using phishing attacks to steal sensitive documents related to trade negotiations and meetings with foreign leaders.
In a series of incidents, Chinese hackers breached U.S. Navy contractors’ systems to steal information including ship maintenance data and missile plans.
Marriott reported a massive data breach that affected up to five hundred million customers in its Starwood hotels reservation system. U.S. private investigators believe China is behind the hack.

titolo: Jiangsu Province Ministry of State Security (JSSD)
descrizione: This threat actor, headquartered in Nanjing, China, is a provincial foreign intelligence arm of China’s Ministry of State Security. Its activities include domestic counterintelligence, nonmilitary foreign intelligence, and political and domestic security. From at least January 2010, this threat actor has targeted U.S. and European commercial airliners for the purpose of stealing trade secrets. Several […]

This threat actor reportedly intruded into American aerospace companies’ computer systems to steal intellectual property and business information, including information related to turbofan engines used in commercial aircraft.

This threat actor targets government and private-sector entities in the defense, maritime, and science and technology sectors in China for espionage purposes. It is particularly interested in information related to cross–Taiwan Strait and U.S.-Sino relations.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, China, Israel, Japan, Switzerland, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets universities around the world for espionage purposes.

titolo: Targeting of organizations associated with trade activity with China
descrizione: A threat actor is targeting multiple organizations with trade ties to China, including those connected with China’s Belt and Road Initiative. The actor also targets organizations in advance of officials’ meetings with Chinese trade officials.
A threat actor compromises opposition parties, as well as organizations charged with overseeing the 2018 Cambodian elections, for espionage purposes.
A threat actor has compromised the network of Australian National University for espionage purposes.
This threat actor targets Tibetan organizations based in India, for the purpose of espionage.
This threat actor uses spear-phishing techniques to target political organizations in Southeast Asia, for the purpose of espionage.
This threat actor targets organizations in the satellite communications, telecommunications, geospatial-imaging, and defense sectors in the United States and Southeast Asia for espionage purposes.
This threat actor targets nongovernmental organizations using Mongolian-themed lures for espionage purposes.

titolo: Compromise of Mongolian government data center
descrizione: A threat actor has compromised a government data center in Mongolia. Kaspersky Lab assesses that the threat actor used its access to compromise websites that they will use in subsequent watering-hole attacks.

titolo: Compromise of a U.S. Navy contractor
descrizione: A threat actor compromises the networks of a contractor for the U.S. Navy, exfiltrating 614 gigabytes of sensitive information, including data related to a new U.S. anti-ship missile and submarine communications systems.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean actors prior to meeting of Donald J. Trump and Kim Jong-un
descrizione: Two separate threat actors targeted South Korean government organizations prior to the meeting between U.S. President Donald J. Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, for the purpose of espionage.

paesi_vittima: China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea (Republic of), United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets software companies and political organizations in the United States, China, Japan, and South Korea. It primarily acts to support cyber operations conducted by other threat actors affiliated with Chinese intelligence services.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, Guatemala, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Thailand, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor targets critical infrastructure and organizations in the entertainment, finance, health-care, education, and telecommunications sectors.
This threat actor targets Japanese media and defense companies for espionage purposes.
This threat actor targets Uighurs—a minority ethnic group located primarily in northwestern China—and devices from Chinese mobile phone manufacturer Xiaomi, for espionage purposes.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation, Taiwan, Thailand, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments as well as technology, education, and telecommunications companies primarily in Asia and the United States, for the purpose of espionage.

The U.S. Department of Justice indicted three members of Boyusec, a China-based internet security firm, on charges including conspiring to commit computer fraud and abuse and conspiring to commit trade-secret theft. The victims included Moody’s Analytics, Siemens, and Trimble. Though not mentioned in the indictment, Boyusec is believed to work on behalf of China’s Ministry […]
This threat actor, using a tool called JadeRAT, targets the mobile phones of ethnic minorities in China, notably Uighurs, for the purpose of espionage.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, Malaysia, The Philippines, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets defense contractors, law firms, engineering firms, shipping companies, and government agencies with responsibilities or business in the maritime industry.

paesi_vittima: China, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation
descrizione: Japan announced a formal link between the threat actor Tick and Chinese intelligence, saying that it was responsible for a series of attacks in Japan. Tick has been active since at least 2008 and has primarily targeted Japan and South Korea. This threat actor targets organizations in the finance, defense, aerospace, technology, health-care, and automotive […]

A threat actor targeted the China Digital Times, a civil-society and news organization based outside China that publishes English- and Chinese-language content, using phishing techniques with the goal of compromising its network.

paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Japan, Russian Federation, Spain, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called WannaCry to encrypt data in compromised networks, and intended to provide the victims with the decryption key only after a ransom had been paid. The threat actors used an exploit, called EternalBlue–first discovered by the U.S. National Security Agency–to propagate WannaCry in organizations using the Windows operating system. On December […]

paesi_vittima: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Finland, France, India, Japan, Korea (Republic of), New Zealand, Norway, South Africa, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Also known as TA410. This threat actor targets managed information technology service providers to access client information for espionage purposes. APT 10 has been active since at least 2009.
This threat actor targets and compromises Japanese and Taiwanese entities in the finance, tech, media, and government sectors.

paesi_vittima: China, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation, Taiwan, United States
descrizione: A threat actor uses a tool called PassCV to target video game companies, stealing digital certificates to use in cyber operations against other targets.

titolo: Compromise of entities involved in the China-Philippines territorial dispute
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the Department of Justice of the Philippines, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), and a major international law firm representing one of the parties in the dispute over the Scarborough Shoal.

paesi_vittima: Belgium, China, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Russian Federation, Rwanda, Sweden
descrizione: This threat actor compromises targets in the Military, telecommunications, and financial sectors in Belgium, China, Iran, Russia, Sweden, and elsewhere.

titolo: Network compromise at the Australian Bureau of Meteorology
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the networks of Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology for espionage purposes.

titolo: Targeting of the government of Thailand
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called Bookworm to compromise government agencies in Thailand, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of the Permanent Court of Arbitration’s website
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the website of the Permanent Course of Arbitration for espionage purposes, intending to compromise visitors to the website.

This threat actor compromises web pages to lure targets for espionage purposes. It focuses on the aerospace, automotive, technology, and energy sectors, primarily in the United States and United Kingdom.
A threat actor compromised the network of United Airlines for espionage purposes, gaining access to flight manifests.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets and compromises entities in the defense, construction, technology, and transportation sectors. Up until 2015, it was primarily focused on U.S. and UK entities, but it shifted to Hong Kong–based targets afterward. The U.S. Department of Justice indicted three members of this threat actor group in November 2017 for compromising the networks of […]
This threat actor targets government agencies and entities in the defense and energy sectors in Southeast Asia with an interest in issues related to tensions in the South China Sea.

paesi_vittima: Cambodia, China, Germany, Lao People's Democratic Republic, The Philippines, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: This threat actor, known to use watering-hole attacks to compromise victims, targets organizations of interest to the Vietnamese government for espionage purposes. Victims have included human rights organizations, research institutes and maritime construction firms in China, and media organizations. Also believed to have been responsible for disclosing confidential Filipino government documents.

This threat actor targets U.S. government entities, the defense industrial base, law firms, information technology companies, resource extraction companies, and nongovernmental organizations. Ethical hacking group Intrusion Truth doxed three members of this threat actor: two hackers plus the head of four Chinese companies who is also believed to be an officer of the Chinese Ministry of […]

paesi_vittima: India, Indonesia, Malaysia, The Philippines, United States
descrizione: This threat actor uses spear-phishing techniques to compromise diplomatic targets in Southeast Asia, India, and the United States. It also seems to have targeted the APT 30.

paesi_vittima: Cambodia, China, India, Indonesia, Korea (Republic of), Malaysia, Myanmar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Thailand, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: This threat actor uses spear-phishing techniques to target government and private sector agencies in the South China Sea region.

A threat actor launched a denial of service attack against GitHub to prevent access to internet content banned in China, such as the New York Times. The incident was the first in which threat actors, believed to be associated with the government of China, used a tool dubbed the Great Cannon.

paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Algeria, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Kenya, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Pakistan, Russian Federation, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Yemen
descrizione: In 2015, Moscow-based Kaspersky Lab published a report on the Equation Group, a threat actor active since 2001 [PDF]. It was responsible for infecting approximately five hundred systems in at least forty-two countries. The malware used by Equation Group had the ability to reprogram hard drives and then self-destruct, which made the operations effectively invisible […]
A threat actor compromised a U.S. health insurance company, resulting in compromised personal data on eighty million customers.

paesi_vittima: Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Israel, Korea (Republic of), Kuwait, Mexico, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments and private sector entities for espionage and sabotage purposes. It is believed to be responsible for compromising U.S. Navy computers at the Navy Marine Corps Intranet in San Diego, the U.S. energy company Calpine Corporation, Saudi Aramco, Pemex, Qatar Airways, and Korean Air (http://www.reuters.com/article/2014/12/02/us-cybersecurity-iran-idUSKCN0JG18I20141202)

titolo: Compromise of the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
descrizione: Threat actors accessed weather network data

titolo: Compromise of the U.S. Postal Service
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the networks of the U.S. Postal Service and gained access to employee data.
A threat actor compromised Apple’s iCloud service in China and intercepted user names and passwords of targeted iCloud users.

Threat actor targeted pro-democracy activists by enticing them to download and install malware-laden Android apps, allowing the threat actors to remotely track and record conversations on compromised phones.

titolo: Compromise of U.S. Transportation Command Contractors
descrizione: A threat actor successfully compromises the networks of contractors for U.S. Transportation Command (TRANSCOM), a military command assigned with moving U.S. military personnel and assets around the world.

This threat actor targets high-tech and manufacturing companies, primarily from Japan, for the purpose of acquiring trade secrets. In 2017, cybersecurity firms released evidence pointing to the threat actor expanding its targets to Russian and Tibetan interests.
This threat actor targets militaries and governments interested in the South China Sea, including the U.S. defense industrial base.

Community Health Systems, a large hospital group in the United States, announced that its computer networks  were compromised, leading to the exfiltration of Social Security numbers and other personal information of approximately 4.5 million people to China.
This threat actor targets organizations in Japan, Taiwan, and elsewhere in East Asia—including electronics manufacturers and telecommunications companies—for espionage purposes.
This threat actor targets human rights groups, government entities, and companies in the pharmaceutical, medical, industrial, and information technology sectors.

paesi_vittima: Argentina, Belgium, Brazil, China, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, France, Germany, Malaysia, Peru, Russian Federation, Spain, Sweden, United States, Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)
descrizione: This threat actor targets military, government entities, and telecommunications providers, primarily in Latin America, for the purpose of espionage.
The contractor responsible for security clearance at the U.S. Department of Homeland Security had their networks hacked and employee information was compromised.

paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Poland, Russian Federation, Spain, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Also known as Bromine. This threat actor targets companies in the education, energy, construction, information technology, and pharmaceutical sectors for the purposes of espionage. It uses malware tailored to target industrial control systems.

titolo: Compromise of Canada’s National Research Council
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the networks of Canada’s National Research Council and exfiltrated data for espionage purposes. The government of Canada confirmed that Chinese state-sponsored actors were responsible.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, The Philippines, Vietnam
descrizione: This threat actor compromises government and military targets in Hong Kong, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia for espionage purposes.
Su Bin, a Chinese national, pleaded guilty to hacking Boeing and other U.S. defense contractors for the purpose of passing confidential information to the People’s Liberation Army.

This threat actor targets firms in the technology (communications, space, aerospace), research, defense, and government sectors in the United States for espionage purposes. The tools and infrastructure it uses overlap with PLA Unit 61398.

In May 2014, the U.S. Department of Justice indicted five members of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Unit 61398, a Chinese army unit dedicated to cyber espionage. According to the Department of Justice, Unit 61398 compromised U.S. corporate networks for trade information potentially useful to Chinese state-owned enterprises. The PLA indictments were the most direct […]
This threat actor targets prodemocratic activists and organizations in Hong Kong, European and international financial institutions, and a U.S.-based think tank.

Threat actors compromised various Australian government ministries for the purposes of espionage. Threat actors allegedly infiltrated blueprints of the Australian Security Intelligence Organization’s new headquarters.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Germany, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets government and private sector entities interested in maritime issues in the South China Sea for espionage purposes

titolo: Compromise of the Indian Defense Research and Development Organization
descrizione: A threat actor compromised India’s Defense Research and Development Organization for espionage purposes.
Threat actors compromised the networks of European Aeronautic Defense and Space Company (EADS) and ThyssenKrupp, defense contractors with offices in Germany.

paesi_vittima: Belgium, Canada, France, India, Israel, Japan, Luxembourg, Norway, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, Taiwan, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: U.S. cybersecurity firm Mandiant, later purchased by FireEye, released a report in February 2013 that exposed one of China’s cyber espionage units, Unit 61398. The group, which FireEye called APT 1, is a unit within China’s People’s Liberation Army (PLA) that has been linked to a wide range of cyber operations targeting U.S. private sector […]
A threat actor compromised Coca-Cola’s network coinciding with the company’s attempted acquisition of China Huiyuan Juice Group.

paesi_vittima: France, India, Spain, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Malware, believed to be linked to Lucky Cat, that facilitates cyber espionage on activists through spear phishing
A threat actor targets computer networks associated with Tibetan activists, as well as military research and development, aerospace, engineering, and shipping industries in India and Japan.
Threat actors compromised the networks of Nortel, a now-defunct telecommunications equipment provider, over an extended period of time for the purposes of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce
descrizione: Threat actors compromised the computer networks of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce
Recurring interference with a joint NASA-U.S. Geological Survey satellite in 2007 and 2008

titolo: Interference with NASA satellite Terra (EOS AM-1)
descrizione: Recurring interference with a NASA observation satellite

paesi_vittima: Argentina, Bangladesh, China, Czech Republic, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, India, Korea (Republic of), Netherlands, Singapore, Taiwan, United Kingdom, United States

titolo: Compromise of a Taiwanese political party
